content.short: TIFO is a sports trivia game with real money prizes, where NFTs act as boosters and grant access to exclusive rewards and experiences.
content.description: TIFO rewards players for their knowledge, not for tapping or farming. NFTs act as in-game boosters that elevate your play and unlock exclusive rewards, prizes, and experiences unavailable to other players. Challenge your sports knowledge with a diverse set of quiz questions and steadily climb the TIFO leaderboard rankings as you demonstrate expertise and earn greater prestige within the community. This immersive approach rewards consistent knowledge and strategic thinking, inviting players to compete fairly while enjoying collectible NFTs that power progress across matches and challenges.
